scope: NBHL ball-hockey only; supplementary experiment independent of the frozen generative VLM selection.
candidate_input: Reuse the exact preselected image crops and edges from the generative VLM protocol, without reference labels.

definitions.veto: Remove shortlisted edges with embedding cosine below threshold; all other original scores/edges remain.
definitions.replace: Use shortlisted embedding cosine as link score and selected threshold as global cutoff.
definitions.blend: Use shortlisted 0.5*OSNet+0.5*embedding cosine as link score and selected threshold as global cutoff.

selection: Development only: maximize correct-10*wrong, then minimize unverified joins, prefer unchanged baseline ties. Select one setting per model/representation before regression scoring; record the overall development winner.
regression: Existing Pittsburgh/Maryland sparse references, previously reviewed. Regression, not untouched validation. Inference may run in parallel but scores are not viewed before selection.
training: None. Generic multimodal retrieval checkpoints with fixed identity instruction. Not a reproduction of ContextReID fine-tuning.
